description:
Report a single event on an issued harness. Authenticated with an HMAC-SHA256 over harness_id || '
' || offset || '
' || event_type || '
' || canonical_json(payload), keyed by the reporting_key returned at issuance. Offsets must be strictly monotonic starting at 0.
name: spoc.harness.report
title: Report a witnessed event on a harness
